title: Docktower Key
summary: Opens the locked watchtower at the Counting House docks.

fields.Acquisition: Cashguard Basher Brammels carries the key. DC 15 Sleight of Hand is an alternate opening method.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
